_comment: Every English local authority district that appears in places.json, mapped to exactly one
`lta` string in ../directory.json — the directory's only key, so a renamed authority breaks
the join loudly, which is the behaviour we want. GENERATED BY RULE by build-places.mjs, and
every entry says which rule made it; an entry marked "exception" says what rule it
overrides and why. `lta: null` means the district's authority has no directory row, and
the reason is in `by`. check-places.mjs holds every one of these promises.
